title: Mjadarah
author: farag4m

step.title: Cook lentils
step.text: Add the lentils, 1.5 cups water, and ½ tsp salt to the pot. Add cumin. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes, then quick release. Remove the lentils to a bowl and set aside temporarily.

step.title: Sauté onions
step.text: Switch the pot to Sauté mode. Cook the sliced onions in olive oil, stirring often, until deep golden brown, about 12-15 minutes. Scoop out a handful of the crispiest onions and set aside for topping.

step.title: Add rice
step.text: Return the cooked lentils to the pot with the onions and their oil. Add the rinsed rice, 3 cups water, and the remaining salt and spices. Stir once.

step.title: Final cook
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes. Let pressure release naturally for 10 minutes.

step.title: Serve
step.text: Fluff and top with the reserved crispy onions.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only method: lentils cook first and are set aside, onions are sautéed separately via the pot's own Sauté mode, then rice + onion oil is pressure cooked together with the lentils.
